clue.text: My sole request about midnight — bring traps round for the old bags

indicators.note: the traps are said to go round the rest, so they enclose it

parts.note: gins are snares or traps for game

indicators.note: the request phrase sits about the midnight letter, so it wraps it

parts.note: a sole request is 'all I ask'
the middle letter of the word night is G

explanation.surface: Someone at midnight asks only that the traps be brought round for some old bags.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bags' is old slang for trousers, so 'the old bags' are antique breeches, not luggage or elderly women.
explanation.definitionFit: Galligaskins were wide loose breeches of the 16th and 17th centuries, and bags is slang for trousers.

clue.text: A bit of a swine, adventuring the last first

indicators.note: the instruction says the final letter of the word is brought round to the front

parts.note: adventuring something is risking it

explanation.surface: A rather nasty person who takes chances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A bit of a swine' reads as an insult, but it means a literal piece of a pig.
explanation.definitionFit: A griskin is the lean cut from the loin of a pig, so a portion of pork.

clue.text: So ghastly a slur I deny, if not in toto

indicators.note: not in toto means only partly, so the answer is found as a part of the words

explanation.surface: Someone denies part of a horrid slur against them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'So' is a link word before the definition. The run of letters sits across slur, I and deny.
explanation.definitionFit: Lurid means shocking or gruesome in a sensational way, close to horrifying.

clue.text: Showing lack of "give' in Catiline's make-up

indicators.note: the make-up of a word is how its letters are composed, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the name Catiline with its S is used as letters

explanation.surface: The Roman conspirator Catiline is described as unyielding by nature.
explanation.walkthrough: Catiline was a Roman conspirator; here the name with its S is only a stock of letters, rearranged by 'make-up'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without stretch or flexibility cannot yield when pulled.

clue.text: Set up thus a victim of Polyphemus

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means read upwards, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus

explanation.surface: Arranged in this way, a casualty of the Cyclops.
explanation.walkthrough: SIC is the Latin word editors insert to mean 'thus written'; in a down light 'Set up' turns it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: In Ovid the shepherd Acis was crushed under a rock by the jealous Cyclops Polyphemus.

clue.text: Drag below the bottom for kingfish catch?

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
an eel is a fish
a haul is a catch of fish

explanation.surface: A large fish is hauled along the seabed as a catch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kingfish' looks like one fish but splits into king plus fish. 'Bottom' is the keel of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Keelhauling was a naval punishment, dragging a sailor under the ship's hull from side to side.

clue.text: This organ has two passages for air

definitions.text: This organ has two passages for air

parts.words: This organ has two passages for air
parts.note: the nose's two nostrils are its air passages, so the clue points at the adjective for that organ

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes what belongs to the nose, the organ with two nostrils carrying breath.

clue.text: Approval thus expressed -a couple of presents, say?

indicators.note: say signals the words are spoken, so their sound gives the entry

parts.note: present in a roll call is 'here', so two of them are here, here

explanation.surface: Applause greets two gifts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'presents' looks like gifts, but means people answering 'present!', or 'here'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is the cry used in Parliament and meetings to endorse a speaker.

clue.text: Sporting association's intelligence men in the Board of Commerce

parts.note: FA is the Football Association, and the 's gives its S
the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency

explanation.surface: Football officials and spies are said to sit on a trade board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board of Commerce' looks like an official body; it is a shopfront sign board.
explanation.definitionFit: A fascia is the sign board above a shop front, bearing the trading name.

clue.text: Is Egyptian god leading the .. chosen people? Only one of them

parts.note: taken as written
Ra is the Egyptian sun god
an elite is a select or chosen group

explanation.surface: Asks whether the Egyptian god heads the chosen people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chosen people' does double duty in the surface: as wordplay it is ELITE, and the definition 'one of them' refers back to the Jews as the chosen people.
explanation.definitionFit: An Israelite is a member of the ancient Hebrew nation, traditionally called God's chosen people.

clue.text: Friend I love seen once a year here in Italy

annotationWithheld.why: Friend I love seen once a year here in Italy (5): no parse found giving SIENA from 'Friend I love seen once a year'; the scan reads the same.
annotationWithheld.clue: Friend I love seen once a year here in Italy

clue.text: Abduct bearer of genetic code during sleep

indicators.note: during the sleep means the code bearer is placed within it

parts.note: kip is British slang for sleep
DNA carries the genetic code

explanation.surface: Snatching a genetic sample while someone is asleep.
explanation.definitionFit: To kidnap someone is to seize and carry them off by force.

clue.text: Angry with style in which role is changed

indicators.note: the style word holds the rest inside it

parts.note: chic means stylish elegance

indicators.note: the letters of role are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: An actor bristles about a chic production where the part has been rewritten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is changed' rearranges the letters of 'role' (giving OLER), which sit inside the style word.
explanation.definitionFit: Choleric means hot-tempered, from the old humour of yellow bile.

clue.text: Deny West's release from prison

indicators.note: the west letter is let out of the prison word, so it is removed

parts.note: Newgate was a notorious old London prison
W is the abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: Someone refuses Mae West's request to be freed from jail.
explanation.walkthrough: NEWGATE was London's famous prison until 1902; releasing W from it leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny something is to nullify or refute it, cancelling its effect.

clue.text: Spring Month once written by Zola

explanation.definitionFit: Germinal was the seventh month of the French Revolutionary calendar, in spring, and the title of Émile Zola's 1885 novel about miners.

clue.text: Billy has article about garland made from a shrub

indicators.note: the name and article go about the garland, so they enclose it

parts.note: Billy Budd is Melville's sailor hero
a is the indefinite article
a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers

explanation.surface: Billy finds a piece about a floral garland made from a bush.
explanation.walkthrough: BUDD and A surround LEI.
explanation.definitionFit: Buddleia is the butterfly bush, a flowering shrub with purple spikes.

clue.text: Like what teacher said, old cart in for repair

indicators.note: the cart is in for repair, so its letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A teacher remarks that an old cart has gone into the workshop.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of OLD CART IN are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctrine is what is taught, so teaching matters are doctrinal.

clue.text: Means of escape studied by the palmist?

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a rope or route to safety and the crease on the hand that palm readers interpret for longevity.

clue.text: Material from a fabulous bird in cock-fighting

indicators.note: the bird is placed inside the cock-fighting word

parts.note: a main is a cock-fighting match
the roc is a giant mythical bird

explanation.surface: Feathers from a mythical bird turn up at a cockfight.
explanation.walkthrough: A main is an old term for a cock-fighting contest, a meaning few solvers now know.
explanation.definitionFit: Marocain is a ribbed crepe dress fabric.

clue.text: Sounds like some cheese that's very, very strong

indicators.note: the clue says the word is spoken, so its sound gives the entry

parts.note: a mitey cheese is one infested with mites

explanation.surface: A ripe cheese described as overpoweringly strong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strong' seems to describe the cheese's smell; old cheese crawling with mites is 'mitey'.
explanation.definitionFit: Mighty means powerful, of great strength.

clue.text: Pioneer of aeronautics, losing at one disastrous swoop

definitions.text: Pioneer of aeronautics, losing at one disastrous swoop

indicators.note: the letters of at one are lost from the bigger word
a disaster wrecks the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: An early aviator loses everything in one fatal dive.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the letters of AT ONE from AERONAUTICS and the remaining six, R A U I C S, are rearranged; 'disastrous swoop' also tells the story of the flyer's fall.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Icarus flew on wax wings, the first flyer, and plunged into the sea when the sun melted them.

clue.text: Wherein one may see motes — after daylight something larger

indicators.note: the larger thing comes after the daylight word

parts.note: the sun gives daylight
the beam is the larger thing set against the mote in the Gospel saying

explanation.surface: Dust specks show in light, and after them something bigger.
explanation.walkthrough: Matthew 7: the mote in your brother's eye versus the beam in your own.
explanation.definitionFit: Dust specks are visible floating in a shaft of light.

clue.text: Faces of about one thousand beautiful goddesses?

indicators.note: the goddesses go about the numbers, enclosing them

parts.note: the Graces were three Greek goddesses of beauty
I is the Roman numeral one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: The faces of roughly a thousand lovely goddesses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'roughly' but is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Grimaces are contorted facial expressions, pulled faces.

clue.text: On the twist, like the resort Noyes recommended

parts.note: as means like
Alfred Noyes wrote 'Go down to Kew in lilac-time', recommending the London district of Kew

explanation.surface: Lopsided, like a holiday spot a poet praised.
explanation.walkthrough: KEW, home of Kew Gardens in London, is the place in Alfred Noyes's poem 'The Barrel-Organ'.
explanation.definitionFit: Askew means crooked or out of line.

clue.text: Circumnavigating the Pole, the hunter's prayer

indicators.note: sailing round something means surrounding it

parts.note: Orion is the hunter of myth and the constellation
S stands for the south pole

explanation.surface: A hunter on a polar voyage says a prayer.
explanation.walkthrough: ORION goes round S.
explanation.definitionFit: An orison is an archaic word for a prayer.

clue.text: Where divine laws broken — by wicked propaganda?

definitions.text: Where divine laws broken — by wicked propaganda?

parts.words: Where divine laws broken — by wicked propaganda?
parts.note: the tablets of the Ten Commandments were smashed by Moses on the mountain after the people were led into worshipping a golden calf

explanation.definitionFit: Mount Sinai is where Moses received the commandments and broke the tablets in anger at the idolatry below.

clue.text: The southern, gull or small merganser

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for southern
a mew is a gull

explanation.surface: Lists the southern gull or a small diving duck.
explanation.definitionFit: The smew is a small diving duck of the merganser group.

clue.text: Sort of suit associated with a caterpillar?

explanation.definitionFit: A tracksuit is athletic wear, and a caterpillar tractor runs on an endless metal belt.

clue.text: Pervasion of cinema with men in disguise

indicators.note: letters in disguise are dressed up in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Disguised men are spread throughout the cinema.
explanation.definitionFit: Immanence is the quality of being present throughout, indwelling.

clue.text: Cicely's bed-fellow?

parts.note: sweet cicely is a herb, so its neighbour in a flower bed is another plant with sweet in its name

explanation.definitionFit: It is a cottage-garden flower, Dianthus barbatus, grown in beds beside herbs.
